detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Turn a two-storey hypermarket into a perfectly organized store!

Hypermarket: Sort & Stock is a large-scale organizing game with 65,146 items waiting to be placed. Work your way through 23 departments across the ground floor, first floor, storage areas and warehouse. Organize everything from fresh produce and bakery goods to fashion, electronics, home storage, toys and seasonal Halloween and Christmas items.

The shop floor is only part of the job. You’ll also place 4,255 boxes on racks in the Cold Room, Dry Storage and Warehouse. Use coin-purchased boosters to find matching items, spot open shelf positions, carry more and reach farther.

65,146 items across 23 departments

Explore every corner of the hypermarket, from the largest grocery department to the warehouse pallet racks.

Ground Floor

• Fresh Produce — 7,427 items across 263 shelves
• Bakery — 2,142 items across 182 shelves
• Promotions & Seasonal — 661 items across 88 shelves
• Dairy & Eggs — 2,808 items across 64 shelves
• Meat & Deli — 1,888 items across 120 shelves
• Frozen — 3,801 items across 266 shelves
• Pet Food & Household — 3,970 items across 160 shelves
• Health & Beauty — 4,661 items across 160 shelves
• Grocery — 11,804 items across 320 shelves
• Snacks & Candy — 4,556 items across 160 shelves
• Beverages — 6,353 items across 178 shelves
• Wine & Spirits — 1,849 items across 72 shelves
• Christmas Shop — 682 items across 53 shelves
• Halloween Shop — 653 items across 72 shelves 

First Floor

• Fashion — 646 items across 50 shelves
• Bedroom & Storage — 220 items across 10 shelves
• Books — 2,240 items across 64 shelves
• Electronics & Appliances — 925 items across 80 shelves
• Toys & Seasonal — 502 items across 112 shelves
• Pet Shop — 3,103 items across 85 shelves 

Storage Areas & Warehouse

• Cold Room — 550 boxes across 155 racks
• Dry Storage — 503 boxes across 125 racks
• Warehouse Pallet Racking — 3,202 boxes across 232 racks 

That’s 60,891 products to organize on the shop floor and 4,255 boxes to place in the storage areas.

Five boosters to help you get organized

Buy boosters with coins and activate them when you need a hand. Every booster lasts 300 seconds.

• Magnet — 25 coins
Highlights nearby loose products and sealed boxes that match the item in your hands. Spot matching items from up to five times your normal reach.

• Spare Pocket — 25 coins
Carry three more products at once.

• Long-Arm — 25 coins
Reach 1.5 metres farther when picking up and placing items.

• Compass — 20 coins
Shows a green preview of the item in your hands at the next free spot on each nearby matching shelf with room. Works with products and boxes on storage shelves, up to five times your normal reach.

• Combo — 40 coins
Earn double coins with every placement.

Key Features

• Organize 65,146 items across 23 departments and four areas.
• Explore a two-storey hypermarket with food, fashion, electronics, books, toys and seasonal shops.
• Sort and place 60,891 products throughout the store.
• Place 4,255 boxes on storage racks and warehouse pallet racking.
• Use five coin-purchased boosters, each lasting five minutes.
• Earn double stars with Combo Bear and use other boosters to find, carry and place items more efficiently.
